slides.title: What nobody tells you before your *first* contract
slides.sub: From a 2nd Officer, for every cadet.

slides.title: Rest hours are a right
slides.body: At least 10 hours in any 24, and 77 in any 7 days. Record them honestly.

slides.title: Download before you join
slides.body: Ship Wi-Fi can be slow or limited. Load your films, music and study notes while you're still ashore.

slides.title: Get tasks signed early
slides.body: Cadets: get your training record book signed task by task, not in your last week on board.

slides.title: Keep your *own* records
slides.body: Keep a copy of every sea service testimonial and discharge entry. Your next certificate depends on sea time you can prove.

slides.question: What do you wish you'd known before your first contract?
slides.line: Ocean Link counts your sea time for you.
